decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

(Reason.  To accord with the provisions of Section 92(1) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990)

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

(Reason.  In order that the Council may be satisfied as to the details of the development in the interests of the visual amenity of the area and to satisfy the requirements of policies ENV B1.1New Development and H6.4 Extensions and alterations.)

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

(Reason.  To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission)

Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times Monday-Saturday 7.00am-11.00pm, Sunday 11.00am-5.00pm .

(Reason.  In order to safeguard the amenities of adjoining residential properties)

Condition : 5 - Before [any] [specified plant and/or machinery] is used on the premises, it shall be [enclosed with sound-insulating material] [and] [mounted in a way which will minimise transmission of structure borne sound] in accordance with a scheme to be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

(Reason.  To safeguard the amenities of adjoining residential property  in accordance with policy ENV.B.1.1 New development and policy ENV.P.1.5 Noise pollution)

Condition : 6 - The scheme approved under condition 3 shall be fully implemented before the (A3 use, specified use, cafe) opens to customers.

(Reason.  To prevent loss of amenity to neighbouring premises due to fumes and smells  in accordance with policy ENV.B.1.1 New development and policy ENV.P.1.6 Air pollution)

Condition : 7 - Any takeaway or delivery service shall remain ancillary to the main use of the premises as a restaurant. The premises shall not operate as a takeaway alone and no separate takeaway are shall be provided.

(Reason: To prevent obstruction ot the adjoining highway as a result of excessive on-street parking associated with a takeaway use.
Condition : 8 - No refuse collection shall take place at the site outside the hours of 6.00am-8.00am.
Condition : 9 - No deliveries shall be taken at or despatched from the site outside the hours of 6.00am-8.00am,  nor at any time on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.

Condition : 10 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions it is considered that this application for change of use from A1 retail to A3 caf? with ancillary takeaway would not harm the character or appearance of the area, or the vitality of this shopping parade and Hounslow Town Centre. It would not have an unacceptable impact upon the surrounding environment or neighbours' living conditions. It complies with adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development) and S.1.4 (Non-retail uses in locations outside primary and secondary frontages within the main shopping areas).
description: Change of use from Retail (A1) to Cafe (A3)
